title: Neon Drift
controls: A / D or ← / → to steer · drag on touch
art_direction: Synthwave night · grid floor · glowing sun
sound: Synth engine hum, pickup blips, crash thump (WebAudio)
prompt: Make an endless 3D hover-racer in one HTML file with Three.js. Steer left/right to dodge pylons and grab energy shards. Speed ramps up, near-misses give bonus. Add camera lean, screen shake on crashes and a particle trail.

title: Swarm Arena
controls: WASD / arrows to move · auto-fire · pick 1 of 3 on level-up
sound: Pew stack, XP chime ladder, level-up sting (WebAudio)
prompt: Make a top-down arena survivor in one HTML file on Canvas 2D. Auto-fire at the nearest enemy, waves that swarm, XP gems, and a pick-1-of-3 upgrade screen on level-up. Add damage numbers, hit-stop and screen shake.

title: Sky Hop
controls: ← / → or A / D to steer · hold Space to hop longer
sound: Bouncy hop pitch ladder, gem sparkle, crumble (WebAudio)
prompt: Make a 3D tile-hopping game in one HTML file with Three.js. A bouncy character auto-hops forward; steer to land on floating tiles that crumble, move and shrink. Low-poly look, fog, smooth follow camera, squash and stretch.

title: Grapple Rush
controls: Hold mouse / Space / touch to grapple · release to fling
sound: Rope zip, wind whoosh by speed, coin ping (WebAudio)
prompt: Make a side-scrolling grappling-hook swinger in one HTML file on Canvas 2D. Hold to fire a rope at the nearest anchor and swing with real pendulum physics, release to fling. Parallax background, speed lines, coins.

title: Core Defender
controls: A / D or ← / → to orbit · auto-fire · drag on touch
sound: Laser ticks, core alarm, shield pulse (WebAudio)
prompt: Make a 3D orbital defence game in one HTML file with Three.js. A ship orbits a glowing core and auto-fires outward at things falling in from every direction. Waves escalate, power-ups drop, the core has health. Fake bloom with additive sprites.

title: Tile Forge
controls: Click / tap a group of 2+ matching tiles
sound: Pitched pops by combo size, heat sizzle (WebAudio)
prompt: Make a tactile collapse puzzle in one HTML file on Canvas 2D. Tap connected groups of same-colour tiles to smelt them; tiles fall with bouncy easing. Bigger groups score exponentially and spawn bombs. Add a heat meter and lots of juice.

title: Pulse Lanes
controls: D F J K (or arrows) · tap a lane on touch
art_direction: Neon night · moonlit skyline · glowing lanes
sound: Live seeded synth track: kick, clap, hats, bass and a pentatonic lead, plus hit ticks (WebAudio)
prompt: Make a four-lane rhythm game in one HTML file on Canvas 2D. Generate the music live with WebAudio from a seeded pattern (kick, hat, bass, a simple melody) and build the note chart from the same step generator, scheduled on AudioContext.currentTime so notes never drift. Tap D F J K or the lanes as notes cross the hit line; Perfect/Good/Miss windows, a combo multiplier, a groove bar that drains on misses, and tempo and density that keep rising. Add lane flashes, hit bursts, combo pops and a screen pulse on every beat.

title: Bank Shot
controls: Drag back from anywhere and release to shoot · arrows aim, hold Space for power
art_direction: Bright miniature park · striped felt · white rails
sound: Pitch-varied wall clacks, bumper boing, cup plunk and star chimes (WebAudio)
prompt: Make a top-down mini golf game in one HTML file on Canvas 2D with 9 short hand-designed holes that scale to fit portrait and landscape. Drag back from the ball and release to shoot, with a dotted trajectory preview and a power ring. Fixed-timestep physics: rolling friction, bouncy angled walls, round bumpers, sliders, a spinner and sand. The cup only swallows a slow ball, faster ones lip out. Par, strokes, 1-3 stars per hole and a scorecard. Add impact squash, wall sparks, a cup plunk with confetti and a gentle camera.

title: Bloom Guard
controls: Click / tap a soil bed, then pick a flower · Space next wave · F speed · 1 2 3 plant, U upgrade, S sell
art_direction: Soft warm garden · terracotta pots · cute pests
sound: Plucky planting chime, seed ticks, spore thumps, pitched pest pops (WebAudio)
prompt: Make a compact garden tower defense in one HTML file on Canvas 2D. Pests walk one winding path toward a greenhouse; tap a soil bed beside the path and plant one of three flowers from a big bottom menu: a fast single-target thistle, a slow splash puffcap that lobs spore bombs, and a lavender aura that slows. Each upgrades once and can be sold. Coins from kills, lives at the greenhouse, 10 waves with a Next wave button, a 2x speed toggle and a boss on wave 10. Lay the map out in a fixed grid that transposes for portrait. Show range on selection, health bars, floating coin numbers, hit flashes and screen shake on leaks.
